_ignoreCommand: PREVIEW BUILDS ARE OFF FOR EVERY BRANCH BUT main, AND THE REASON IS MEASURED.
Exit 0 skips the build; exit 1 proceeds. Vercel's free tier allows 100 builds
in a ROLLING window (not the '24 hours' the error message claims -- it has
cleared in 30-60 minutes every time). On 2026-08-24 our own branch pushes spent
it and Vercel posted a FAILING commit status on an open pull request, which
blocks a merge on a board that has nothing to do with the change under review.
Nobody opens the preview URLs: merges gate on staging-matrix-gate. So we were
spending a build budget purely to receive a status that could only ever hurt.
THE ABSENT REF BUILDS RATHER THAN SKIPS, and that asymmetry is deliberate. A
bare != test exits 0 on an empty VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF, so an unset variable
would silently stop deploying production -- the same shape as the edge deploy
that failed at setup and left main looking healthy with stale functions. Fail
open: skip only when the ref is PRESENT and is not main.
IN THE REPO RATHER THAN THE DASHBOARD, on purpose. A project setting is
invisible state nobody can trace back; this reverts with one commit and is
WHAT THIS COSTS: no preview URL to eyeball a UI change before merge. If that
is wanted back for the web-facing branches, scope the condition to a branch
name pattern rather than deleting it.
